You are an autonomous agent that will only interact with the environment.

Take into account that the measurements, simulations and other experiments are expensive. Try always to minimize costs and avoid unnecessary actions.

Task Guide: Task: 
Task: Melting of Aluminum - Level 1
Description: Simulate the melting of Aluminum by heating under NPT conditions using the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Compute the mean squared displacement (MSD) of Al atoms over the trajectory using the MDAnalysis library. Identify the melting point as the first frame where the MSD shows a sudden jump, ignoring the first 50 ps of simulation. Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state using the MSD after the detected melting point, and report the average value in m²/s.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 5.55e-10)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- timestep: 0.001 picoseconds
- npt heating steps: 200000
- npt heating initial temperature: 300
- npt heating final temperature: 1500
- npt heating pressure: 0.0
- npt_heating_thermostat: Nose-Hoover
- npt_heating_barostat: Nose-Hoover
- materials_project_id: mp-134
- atom_style: atomic

    "content": "\
import MDAnalysis as mda\n\
from MDAnalysis.analysis.msd import EinsteinMSD\n\
import numpy as np\n\
\n\
# Load the trajectory\n\
u = mda.Universe('/results/gpt_4o/react/melting/subtask_false/level_1/brief/aluminum_melting_1_trial_3/al_structure.data', \
                 '/results/gpt_4o/react/melting/subtask_false/level_1/brief/aluminum_melting_1_trial_3/dump.lammpstrj', \
                 format='LAMMPSDUMP')\n\
\n\
# Select all atoms\n\
atoms = u.select_atoms('all')\n\
\n\
# Compute MSD\n\
msd = EinsteinMSD(atoms, select='all', msd_type='xyz', fft=True)\n\
msd.run()\n\
\n\
# Ignore the first 50 ps (50000 steps)\n\
time = msd.times[50000:]\n\
msd_values = msd.results.msd[50000:]\n\
\n\
# Identify the melting point as the first frame where MSD shows a sudden jump\n\
melting_point_index = np.argmax(np.diff(msd_values) > 0.1)\n\
melting_point_time = time[melting_point_index]\n\
\n\
# Compute the diffusion constant in the molten state\n\
diffusion_constant = np.mean(np.diff(msd_values[melting_point_index:]) / np.diff(time[melting_point_index:])) / 6\n\
\n\
# Save the results\n\
with open('/results/gpt_4o/react/melting/subtask_false/level_1/brief/aluminum_melting_1_trial_3/results.txt', 'w') as f:\n\
    f.write(f'{diffusion_constant:.2e}')\n\
"
